newsitem.title: ITALY: Air Madagascar to restart Rome service in December.
newsitem.headline: Air Madagascar to restart Rome service in December.

text.p: ROME, Oct 14 - Air Madagascar plans to restart a weekly Rome service, after a nine year break, using a Boeing 747-200 aircraft from December 18, sales director Roland Ranjatoelina told a news conference.
He said final discussions for the flight are now taking place with the Italian authorities.
The outbound flight for Anatananarivo coming from Paris will be on Wednesdays, while the inward flight will stop at Rome on Thursdays en route to Paris.
